senses.en_definition: A bow used to play a string instrument, or a curved line forming part of a circle.
senses.zh_definition: 用于演奏弦乐器的弓；也指构成圆周一部分的弧线。
senses.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex jindaqq strument tal-kordi, jew linja mgħawġa li tifforma parti minn ċirku.

senses.zh_definition: 弓，例如演奏弦乐器时使用的琴弓。
弧；弧线。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: L-istudent immarka żewġ punti fuq iċ-ċirku u pinġa ark bejniethom.
formal.en: The student marked two points on the circle and drew an arc between them.
formal.zh: 学生在圆上标出两个点，并在两点之间画了一段弧。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-ark tal-vjolin? David: Fil-kaxxa, ħdejn il-vjolin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the violin bow? David: In the case, beside the violin.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：小提琴弓在哪里？戴维：在琴盒里，小提琴旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (小提琴学生)
messages.zh: 小提琴弓在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the violin bow?

messages.speaker: David (音乐教师)
messages.zh: 在琴盒里，小提琴旁边。
messages.en: In the case, beside the violin.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张 ark 图卡：一张画小提琴弓，一张画圆弧；分别配上 tal-vjolin 和 ta' ċirku，靠搭配区分词义。

senses.en_definition: Laundry: clothes or other textiles to be washed, or the work or service of washing them.
senses.zh_definition: 需要清洗的衣物等纺织品，也指清洗这些物品的工作或服务。
senses.mt_definition: Ħwejjeġ jew drappijiet għall-ħasil, jew ix-xogħol jew is-servizz tal-ħasil tagħhom.

senses.zh_definition: 洗衣；待洗或送洗的衣物；洗衣服务，具体含义依语境而定。
洗衣；待洗或送洗的衣物；洗衣服务，具体含义依语境而定。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Il-lukanda toffri servizz tal-londri lill-klijenti tagħha.
formal.en: The hotel offers a laundry service to its guests.
formal.zh: 这家酒店为住客提供洗衣服务。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hi l-borża tal-londri? Ġanni: Fil-kamra tal-banju, ħdejn il-magna tal-ħasil.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the laundry bag? Ġanni: In the bathroom, next to the washing machine.
colloquial.zh: Marija：洗衣袋在哪里？Ġanni：在浴室里，洗衣机旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 洗衣袋在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the laundry bag?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.zh: 在浴室里，洗衣机旁边。
messages.en: In the bathroom, next to the washing machine.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“装袋、送洗、取回”的生活画面记 londri；把 borża tal-londri 与 servizz tal-londri 分别对应洗衣袋和洗衣服务。

senses.en_definition: Television: the medium that broadcasts moving pictures and sound, or the programmes watched through it.
senses.zh_definition: 电视这种传播图像和声音的媒介，也可指观看的电视节目。
senses.mt_definition: Il-mezz li jxandar stampi li jiċċaqalqu u ħoss, jew il-programmi li wieħed jara permezz tiegħu.

senses.zh_definition: 电视；电视广播或电视节目。
电视；电视广播或电视节目。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Dan il-programm tat-televixin jippreżenta tagħrif dwar l-annimali b'lingwaġġ sempliċi għat-tfal.
formal.en: This television programme presents information about animals in language that is simple for children.
formal.zh: 这个电视节目用适合儿童的简单语言介绍动物知识。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tara t-televixin wara l-ikel? Pawlu: Iva, hemm programm dwar il-baħar. Lara: Mela narawh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to watch television after dinner? Pawlu: Yes, there's a programme about the sea. Lara: Then let's watch it together.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：晚饭后想看电视吗？保罗：想，有个关于海洋的节目。拉拉：那我们一起看吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 晚饭后想看电视吗？
messages.en: Do you want to watch television after dinner?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，有个关于海洋的节目。
messages.en: Yes, there's a programme about the sea.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们一起看吧。
messages.en: Then let's watch it together.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 用固定搭配 nara t-televixin 记住“看电视”；把遥控器、屏幕和节目连成一个生活场景，同时留意词尾拼写是 xin。

senses.en_definition: Relating to the Soviet Union, its people, institutions, or culture.
senses.zh_definition: 与苏联及其人民、机构或文化有关的。
senses.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Unjoni Sovjetika, man-nies tagħha, mal-istituzzjonijiet tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

senses.zh_definition: 苏联的；与苏联有关的。
属于苏联或与苏联有关的。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jinkludi deskrizzjoni ta' poster sovjetiku.
formal.en: The museum catalogue includes a description of a Soviet poster.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录收录了一张苏联海报的介绍。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan film sovjetiku? David: Iva, il-programm jgħid li sar fl-Unjoni Sovjetika.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this a Soviet film? David: Yes, the programme says it was made in the Soviet Union.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这是一部苏联电影吗？David：是的，节目单上说它是在苏联拍摄的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是一部苏联电影吗？
messages.en: Is this a Soviet film?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-programm jgħid li sar fl-Unjoni Sovjetika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-programm jgħid li sar fl-Unjoni Sovjetika.
messages.zh: 是的，节目单上说它是在苏联拍摄的。
messages.en: Yes, the programme says it was made in the Soviet Union.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sovjetiku 和英语 Soviet 并排写在苏联电影海报旁，用拼写相似处与海报画面记住“苏联的”。

senses.en_definition: Cardboard as a material; also a humorous drawing or comic strip, or an animated cartoon.
senses.zh_definition: 可指纸板这种材料，也可指幽默漫画、连环漫画或动画片，具体含义由语境决定。
senses.mt_definition: Materjal magħmul minn karta ħoxna; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll tpinġija umoristika, sensiela ta' tpinġijiet jew film animat.

senses.zh_definition: 纸板；用于制作盒子等物品的厚纸质材料。
漫画；幽默图画或连环漫画。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Il-kelma kartun tista' tirreferi għall-materjal ta' kaxxa, għal tpinġija umoristika jew għal film animat.
formal.en: The word kartun can refer to the material of a box, a humorous drawing, or an animated cartoon.
formal.zh: kartun 一词可以指箱子所用的纸板材料、幽默漫画或动画片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi trid tagħmel wara l-ikel? Ben: Irrid nara kartun fuq it-televiżjoni. Maja: Tajjeb, nagħżlu wieħed flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you want to do after eating? Ben: I want to watch a cartoon on television. Maja: Okay, let's choose one together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：吃完饭你想做什么？Ben：我想在电视上看动画片。Maja：好，我们一起选一部。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 吃完饭你想做什么？
messages.en: What do you want to do after eating?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.zh: 我想在电视上看动画片。
messages.en: I want to watch a cartoon on television.

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 好，我们一起选一部。
messages.en: Okay, let's choose one together.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象纸板箱、报纸漫画和电视动画三个画面，用周围的词判断 kartun 在说哪一个。

senses.en_definition: Velvet, a fabric with a soft surface; also something soft and pleasant to touch.
senses.zh_definition: 天鹅绒，一种表面柔软的织物；也指摸起来柔软舒适的东西。
senses.mt_definition: Drapp b'wiċċ artab; ukoll xi ħaġa ratba li tagħti sensazzjoni pjaċevoli meta tmissha.

senses.zh_definition: 天鹅绒。

senses.en_definition: sth. soft and pleasant to the touch
senses.zh_definition: 触感柔软舒适的东西。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Għall-purtieri tas-sala ntgħażel bellus aħmar minħabba d-dehra eleganti tiegħu.
formal.en: Red velvet was chosen for the hall's curtains because of its elegant appearance.
formal.zh: 大厅的窗帘选用了红色天鹅绒，因为它看起来很典雅。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-kuxxin artab ħafna. Marija: Veru, qisu bellus meta tmissu.
colloquial.en: Anna: This cushion is very soft. Marija: It really is; it feels like velvet.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个靠垫真软。玛丽亚：确实，摸起来像天鹅绒。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个靠垫真软。
messages.en: This cushion is very soft.

messages.speaker: Marija (店员)
messages.zh: 确实，摸起来像天鹅绒。
messages.en: It really is; it feels like velvet.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指轻轻划过天鹅绒表面，把 bellus 和柔软舒服的触感一起记住。

senses.en_definition: Jellyfish: soft-bodied sea animals that may sting.
senses.zh_definition: 水母：身体柔软、部分种类会蜇人的海洋动物。
senses.mt_definition: Annimali tal-baħar b'ġisem artab li jistgħu jniggżu.

senses.zh_definition: 水母。
水母。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Minħabba l-preżenza ta' bram fil-bajja, l-għawwiema ġew avżati biex joqogħdu attenti.
formal.en: Because of the presence of jellyfish in the bay, swimmers were advised to be careful.
formal.zh: 由于海湾里有水母，游泳者被提醒要小心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm bram fl-ilma? Mark: Iva, rajt ftit ħdejn ix-xatt. Ejja nibqgħu hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are there jellyfish in the water? Mark: Yes, I saw a few near the shore. Let's stay here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：水里有水母吗？马克：有，我在岸边看见了几只。我们就待在这里吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 水里有水母吗？
messages.en: Are there jellyfish in the water?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rajt ftit ħdejn ix-xatt. Ejja nibqgħu hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rajt ftit ħdejn ix-xatt. Ejja nibqgħu hawn.
messages.zh: 有，我在岸边看见了几只。我们就待在这里吧。
messages.en: Yes, I saw a few near the shore. Let's stay here.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bram 和海边看见一群透明水母的画面绑定，再用 ħafna bram 记住“很多水母”。

senses.en_definition: A device that controls the flow of water from a pipe; also a threaded fastener used to hold things together.
senses.zh_definition: 控制水管出水的水龙头；也指通过螺纹固定物件的螺钉。
senses.mt_definition: Apparat li jikkontrolla l-ħruġ tal-ilma minn pajp; ukoll biċċa tal-metall bil-kamin li tintuża biex twaħħal affarijiet flimkien.

senses.zh_definition: 水龙头；控制水流开关的装置。
水龙头，常见于洗手盆或厨房水槽。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Wara li tuża l-ilma, agħlaq il-vit biex tevita l-ħela.
formal.en: After using the water, turn off the tap to avoid waste.
formal.zh: 用水后请关上水龙头，以免浪费。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex dan l-ixkaff jik 움직? Rita: Hemm vit maħlul; irridu nissikkawh.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is this shelf moving? Rita: There is a loose screw; we need to tighten it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个架子怎么会晃？丽塔：有一颗螺钉松了，我们得把它拧紧。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 这个架子怎么会晃？
messages.en: Why is this shelf moving?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 有一颗螺钉松了，我们得把它拧紧。
messages.en: There is a loose screw; we need to tighten it.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“转动”连接两个画面：转水龙头控制水流，转螺钉固定架子；再靠上下文分义。

senses.en_definition: A built-up area where people live.
senses.zh_definition: 有人居住、房屋等建筑较为集中的区域。
senses.mt_definition: Żona mibnija fejn jgħixu n-nies.

senses.zh_definition: 有人居住的地方。
有人群居住的地方。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Il-proġett jipprevedi triq ġdida fit-tarf tal-abitat.
formal.en: The project provides for a new road at the edge of the built-up area.
formal.zh: 该项目规划在建成区边缘修建一条新路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-razzett jinsab ħdejn id-djar? Mark: Le, jinsab barra mill-abitat, ħdejn l-għelieqi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the farm near the houses? Mark: No, it is outside the built-up area, near the fields.
colloquial.zh: Maja：农场在那些房子附近吗？Mark：不，在建成区外面，靠近田地。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 农场在那些房子附近吗？
messages.en: Is the farm near the houses?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jinsab barra mill-abitat, ħdejn l-għelieqi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jinsab barra mill-abitat, ħdejn l-għelieqi.
messages.zh: 不，在建成区外面，靠近田地。
messages.en: No, it is outside the built-up area, near the fields.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上房屋密集、有人生活的一片区域，用 abitat 给它贴标签，再用“区域边缘”和“区域外面”两个场景巩固记忆。

senses.zh_definition: 突然发生、事先没有预兆的。
senses.mt_definition: Li jiġri għal għarrieda u mingħajr twissija.

senses.zh_definition: 突然的；骤然发生的。
突然地；骤然。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi waqfien ħesrem tas-servizz minħabba ħsara teknika.
formal.en: The report describes a sudden interruption of the service due to a technical fault.
formal.zh: 报告描述了技术故障导致的服务突然中断。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaf il-film ħesrem? Pawlu: Naħseb li nqata' l-internet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the film suddenly stop? Pawlu: I think the internet connection dropped.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影怎么突然停了？保罗：我想是断网了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影怎么突然停了？
messages.en: Why did the film suddenly stop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想是断网了。
messages.en: I think the internet connection dropped.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħesrem 分设两张记忆卡：一张画突然停止的电影，一张画未熟的酸葡萄；分别记忆，避免混义。

senses.en_definition: Disgrace or shame caused by behaviour that damages a person's or group's honour or reputation.
senses.zh_definition: 因某种行为损害个人或群体的荣誉、名声而产生的耻辱或羞辱。
senses.mt_definition: Telf ta' ġieħ jew ta' reputazzjoni minħabba mġiba ħażina jew mhux xierqa.

senses.zh_definition: 耻辱；使人蒙羞的事或状态
失去荣誉；蒙羞；名节受损

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i. għ-/h- words may take contextual l-i- after consonants.

formal.mt: L-imġiba tal-mexxej ġabet għajb fuq l-organizzazzjoni kollha.
formal.en: The leader's behaviour brought disgrace on the entire organisation.
formal.zh: 这位领导人的行为使整个组织蒙羞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt kif tkellem mal-anzjan? Mark: Iva, dak kien għajb. Messu talab skuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear how he spoke to the elderly man? Mark: Yes, that was disgraceful. He should have apologised.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到他怎么跟那位老人说话了吗？马克：听到了，真丢脸。他本该道歉的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到他怎么跟那位老人说话了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear how he spoke to the elderly man?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak kien għajb. Messu talab skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak kien għajb. Messu talab skuża.
messages.zh: 听到了，真丢脸。他本该道歉的。
messages.en: Yes, that was disgraceful. He should have apologised.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 把għajb和“行为让自己及家人蒙羞”的情境连接；它强调耻辱和名誉受损，比普通的不好意思更重。

senses.en_definition: The sleepy feeling that makes someone want to sleep; also sleep itself.
senses.zh_definition: 使人想要睡觉的困倦感觉，也可指睡眠本身。
senses.mt_definition: Il-ħtieġa jew ix-xewqa li wieħed jorqod; jista' jfisser ukoll l-irqad innifsu.

senses.zh_definition: 睡眠；睡觉
困意；困倦；昏昏欲睡的感觉

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa twila, qabadni n-ngħas u bdejt insibha diffiċli biex nikkonċentra.
formal.en: During the long meeting, I became sleepy and began to find it difficult to concentrate.
formal.zh: 在漫长的会议中，我开始犯困，逐渐难以集中注意力。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi n-ngħas. Se mmur norqod. Lara: Sewwa, nitkellmu għada.
colloquial.en: Mark: I am sleepy. I am going to bed. Lara: All right, we will talk tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我困了，要去睡觉了。Lara：好，我们明天再聊。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我困了，要去睡觉了。
messages.en: I am sleepy. I am going to bed.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们明天再聊。
messages.en: All right, we will talk tomorrow.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 先用打哈欠的画面记住ngħas的困意和睡眠义，再另画一个指向太阳穴的箭头，分别记忆同形的身体部位义。

senses.en_definition: To bake bread frequently or put loaves into an oven for baking.
senses.zh_definition: 经常烤面包，或把一条条面包放入烤炉烘烤。
senses.mt_definition: Jaħmi l-ħobż ta' spiss jew idaħħal il-ħobż fil-forn biex jinħema.

senses.zh_definition: 经常烘烤；频繁烤面包。

senses.en_definition: to put loaves in an oven
senses.zh_definition: 把面包放入烤炉中。

formal.mt: Wara li l-għaġina kienet lesta, il-furnar ħabbeż il-ħobż fil-forn.
formal.en: Once the dough was ready, the baker put the loaves into the oven.
formal.zh: 面团准备好后，面包师把面包放进了烤炉。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-furnar diġà ħabbeż il-ħobż fil-forn? Pawlu: Iva, għadu kemm daħħlu. Nistennew ftit.
colloquial.en: Rita: Has the baker already put the loaves into the oven? Pawlu: Yes, he's just put them in. Let's wait a little.

messages.zh: 面包师已经把面包放进烤炉了吗？
messages.en: Has the baker already put the loaves into the oven?

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包师每天把一炉炉面包送进烤炉，同时记住“经常烤”和“把面包入炉”两个相关场景。

senses.en_definition: A dictionary or collection of words that records their meanings or use.
senses.zh_definition: 收录词语并说明其意义或用法的词典或词汇集。
senses.mt_definition: Dizzjunarju jew ġabra ta' kliem bit-tifsir jew bl-użu tiegħu.

senses.zh_definition: 词典；供查阅词语及其释义等信息的工具书。
词汇；词汇集，指某种语言或某一领域的词语集合。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: L-istudenti jistgħu jużaw milsen bilingwi biex jifhmu l-kliem fit-test.
formal.en: Students may use a bilingual dictionary to understand the words in the text.
formal.zh: 学生可以使用双语词典来理解课文中的词语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser din il-kelma? Mark: Ma nafx. Ejja nfittxuha fil-milsen.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this word mean? Mark: I don't know. Let's look it up in the dictionary.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个词是什么意思？马克：我不知道。我们查一下词典吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this word mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我不知道。我们查一下词典吧。
messages.en: I don't know. Let's look it up in the dictionary.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本封面写着 milsen 的词典：遇到生词就翻开它，把“查词”的动作和这个名词一起记。

senses.en_definition: The activity or sound of drumming or making a crashing noise; also, brainwashing.
senses.zh_definition: 击鼓的活动或声音，也可指制造轰响；另有洗脑之义。
senses.mt_definition: Id-daqq tat-tanbur jew ħoss qawwi ta' tħabbit; ukoll, influwenza ripetuta biex tbiddel il-ħsieb ta' xi ħadd.

senses.zh_definition: 击鼓；打鼓声。
制造轰响或响亮撞击声的行为。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: It-tanbir ritmiku akkumpanja l-purċissjoni tul it-triq prinċipali.
formal.en: Rhythmic drumming accompanied the procession along the main street.
formal.zh: 有节奏的鼓声伴随着队伍沿主街前进。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tisma' dak it-tanbir? Mark: Iva, ġej mis-sala; il-grupp qed jipprova għall-kunċert.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear that drumming? Mark: Yes, it's coming from the hall; the group is rehearsing for the concert.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听到那阵鼓声了吗？马克：听到了，是从礼堂传来的，乐团正在为音乐会排练。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那阵鼓声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that drumming?

messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mis-sala; il-grupp qed jipprova għall-kunċert.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mis-sala; il-grupp qed jipprova għall-kunċert.
messages.zh: 听到了，是从礼堂传来的，乐团正在为音乐会排练。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the hall; the group is rehearsing for the concert.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“听见一阵鼓声”记住名词用法，再把“洗脑”单独做成义项卡，按上下文区分。

senses.en_definition: A preparation applied to shoes to polish them and improve their appearance.
senses.zh_definition: 涂在鞋面上，用于擦亮鞋子、改善外观的鞋油或擦鞋膏。
senses.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex tillostra ż-żraben u ttejjeb id-dehra tagħhom.

senses.zh_definition: 鞋油；用于擦亮鞋子的膏剂。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Qabel iċ-ċerimonja, l-impjegat illostra ż-żraben bil-blakk u mbagħad għaddielhom ċarruta nadifa.
formal.en: Before the ceremony, the employee polished his shoes with shoe polish and then wiped them with a clean cloth.
formal.zh: 典礼前，这名员工用鞋油擦亮鞋子，随后用干净的布擦拭。

colloquial.mt: Karl: Fejn qiegħed il-blakk? Irrid nillostra ż-żraben. Rita: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-bieb, maġenb ix-xkupilja.
colloquial.en: Karl: Where's the shoe polish? I want to polish my shoes. Rita: In the drawer by the door, next to the brush.
colloquial.zh: 卡尔：鞋油在哪儿？我想擦鞋。丽塔：在门边的抽屉里，刷子旁边。

messages.speaker: Karl (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn qiegħed il-blakk? Irrid nillostra ż-żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn qiegħed il-blakk? Irrid nillostra ż-żraben.
messages.zh: 鞋油在哪儿？我想擦鞋。
messages.en: Where's the shoe polish? I want to polish my shoes.

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 在门边的抽屉里，刷子旁边。
messages.en: In the drawer by the door, next to the brush.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 blakk 与鞋刷、鞋油罐和擦亮的皮鞋一起记，牢牢记住它是擦鞋用品。

senses.en_definition: To fasten a book's pages together and attach them to a cover.
senses.zh_definition: 把书页固定在一起并配上封面，装订成册。
senses.mt_definition: Għaqqad il-paġni ta' ktieb u waħħalhom ma' qoxra.

senses.zh_definition: 装订书籍；将书页装订成册。

formal.mt: Il-legatur bbajndja l-volum b'qoxra iebsa qabel ma ntbagħat lill-librerija.
formal.en: The bookbinder bound the volume in a hard cover before it was sent to the library.
formal.zh: 装订师将该卷书精装成册后，书才被送往图书馆。

colloquial.mt: Marta: It-teżi tiegħek lesta biex tissottomettiha? Pawlu: Iva, il-legatur bbajndja t-teżi lbieraħ, u se niġborha llum.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is your thesis ready to submit? Pawlu: Yes, the bookbinder bound it yesterday, and I'm picking it up today.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你的论文准备好提交了吗？保罗：准备好了，装订师昨天把论文装订好了，我今天去取。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 你的论文准备好提交了吗？
messages.en: Is your thesis ready to submit?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (准备提交论文的学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-legatur bbajndja t-teżi lbieraħ, u se niġborha llum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-legatur bbajndja t-teżi lbieraħ, u se niġborha llum.
messages.zh: 准备好了，装订师昨天把论文装订好了，我今天去取。
messages.en: Yes, the bookbinder bound it yesterday, and I'm picking it up today.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一叠散页经过固定、加封面，变成一本完整的书；把 bbajndja 和“散页变成册”的动作连在一起，再用书籍与论文两个例子复习。

senses.en_definition: To connect two sides of a gap, valley, or waterway by means of a bridge.
senses.zh_definition: 通过架设桥梁，把间隔、山谷或水道的两侧连接起来。
senses.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad żewġ naħat ta' vojt, wied jew passaġġ tal-ilma permezz ta' pont.

senses.en_definition: to bridge (to connect with a bridge)
senses.zh_definition: 架桥；用桥把两侧连接起来。

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur bbriġġja l-wied biex jgħaqqad iż-żewġ irħula.
formal.en: The contractor bridged the valley to connect the two villages.
formal.zh: 承包商在山谷上架桥，把两个村庄连接起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għaqqdu ż-żewġ naħat tal-wied? Toni: Il-kuntrattur bbriġġja l-wied, u issa nistgħu naqsmu bil-mixi.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did they connect the two sides of the valley? Toni: The contractor bridged the valley, and now we can cross on foot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们是怎么把山谷两侧连起来的？托尼：承包商在山谷上架了桥，现在我们可以步行过去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.zh: 他们是怎么把山谷两侧连起来的？
messages.en: How did they connect the two sides of the valley?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kuntrattur bbriġġja l-wied, u issa nistgħu naqsmu bil-mixi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kuntrattur bbriġġja l-wied, u issa nistgħu naqsmu bil-mixi.
messages.zh: 承包商在山谷上架了桥，现在我们可以步行过去了。
messages.en: The contractor bridged the valley, and now we can cross on foot.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象山谷两边原本不通，中间架起一座桥；把这个动作与“架桥连接”一起记。

senses.en_definition: A large bird of prey that feeds mainly on dead animals.
senses.zh_definition: 主要以动物尸体为食的大型猛禽，即兀鹫。
senses.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża kbir li jiekol l-aktar annimali mejta.

senses.zh_definition: 兀鹫；主要以动物尸体为食的大型猛禽。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt juri avultun bil-ġwienaħ miftuħa fuq blata.
formal.en: The photograph shows a vulture with its wings spread on a rock.
formal.zh: 照片中，一只兀鹫站在岩石上，展开双翅。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak l-għasfur kbir? Mark: Dak avultun. Ħares lejn il-ġwienaħ tiegħu!
colloquial.en: Sara: What is that big bird? Mark: That's a vulture. Look at its wings!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那只大鸟是什么？马克：那是兀鹫。看看它的翅膀！

messages.speaker: 萨拉 (游客)
messages.zh: 那只大鸟是什么？
messages.en: What is that big bird?

messages.speaker: 马克 (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak avultun. Ħares lejn il-ġwienaħ tiegħu!
messages.mt_standard: Dak avultun. Ħares lejn il-ġwienaħ tiegħu!
messages.zh: 那是兀鹫。看看它的翅膀！
messages.en: That's a vulture. Look at its wings!

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 avultun，就想象天空中一只展开大翅膀的兀鹫；用这幅画面把词形和鸟名牢牢连在一起。

senses.en_definition: Makeup used to add colour to the cheeks; also fluted or pleated fabric used as a decorative trim.
senses.zh_definition: 指给面颊增添颜色的腮红；也指用作装饰的起褶或打褶织物。
senses.mt_definition: Prodott tal-irtokk li jagħti l-kulur lill-ħaddejn; ukoll drapp bil-piegi li jintuża bħala tiżjin.

senses.zh_definition: 腮红，用于给面颊增添颜色的化妆品。
褶饰织物；带有槽褶或打褶效果的装饰性布料。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Il-libsa għandha ruxx madwar l-għonq bħala tiżjin.
formal.en: The dress has a ruche around the neckline as decoration.
formal.zh: 这条连衣裙的领口周围有一圈褶饰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li għandi bżonn aktar ruxx fuq ħaddejja? Lara: Le, diġà għandek biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think I need more blush on my cheeks? Lara: No, you already have enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得我脸上还需要再涂些腮红吗？拉拉：不用，已经够了。

messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li għandi bżonn aktar ruxx fuq ħaddejja?
messages.zh: 你觉得我脸上还需要再涂些腮红吗？
messages.en: Do you think I need more blush on my cheeks?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.en: No, you already have enough.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ruxx 画两张独立小图：一张是面颊上的腮红，一张是衣领上的褶饰；看到化妆或服装语境时，分别选择对应义项。

senses.en_definition: Burkina Faso, a country in West Africa formerly called Upper Volta.
senses.zh_definition: 布基纳法索，位于西非的国家，旧称上沃尔特。
senses.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent li qabel kien jissejjaħ Upper Volta.

senses.en_definition: Burkina Faso (a country in West Africa, formerly Upper Volta; official name: Burkina Faso)
senses.zh_definition: 布基纳法索，位于西非的国家，旧称上沃尔特；正式国名为布基纳法索。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-ġeografija jiddeskrivi l-Burkina Faso bħala pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent.
formal.en: The geography report describes Burkina Faso as a country in West Africa.
formal.zh: 这份地理报告将布基纳法索介绍为一个位于西非的国家。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn jinsab il-Burkina Faso? Adam: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is Burkina Faso? Adam: In West Africa. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：布基纳法索在哪里？亚当：在西非。我们在地图上找找它吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 布基纳法索在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Burkina Faso?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在西非。我们在地图上找找它吧。
messages.en: In West Africa. Let's find it on the map.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Burkina Faso 分成两个书写单元，对应中文“布基纳／法索”，再在词卡旁标注“西非”。

senses.en_definition: A specialist who studies human sexuality.
senses.zh_definition: 专门研究人类性与性相关现象的学者或专家。
senses.mt_definition: Speċjalista li jistudja s-sesswalità tal-bniedem.

senses.zh_definition: 性学家，专门研究人类性与性相关现象的学者或专家。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Is-sessologu mistieden ippreżenta r-riċerka tiegħu dwar is-sesswalità tal-bniedem.
formal.en: The guest sexologist presented his research on human sexuality.
formal.zh: 受邀性学家介绍了他关于人类性的研究。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jitkellem fil-laqgħa? Mark: Sessologu. Se jispjega x'jistudja fix-xogħol tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to speak at the meeting? Mark: A sexologist. He will explain what he studies in his work.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁要在会上发言？Mark：一位性学家。他会介绍自己的研究内容。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动参加者)
messages.zh: 谁要在会上发言？
messages.en: Who is going to speak at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Sessologu. Se jispjega x'jistudja fix-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Sessologu. Se jispjega x'jistudja fix-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.zh: 一位性学家。他会介绍自己的研究内容。
messages.en: A sexologist. He will explain what he studies in his work.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讲台上的研究者：sessologu 是“性学家”这个人，sessoloġija 是“性学”这门学科，成对区分。

senses.en_definition: The shape and physical features of an area of land, or the study and description of those features.
senses.zh_definition: 某片土地的形状、起伏及其他地表特征，也指对这些特征的研究和描述。
senses.mt_definition: Il-forma u l-karatteristiċi fiżiċi tal-art f'żona, jew l-istudju u d-deskrizzjoni tagħhom.

senses.zh_definition: 地形；地表形态及其特征；研究或描述这些特征的地形学。

definite_article.note: Canonical citation context; preceding vowels may elide article i.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-topografija taż-żona u juri l-għoljiet u l-widien fuq mappa.
formal.en: The report describes the area's topography and shows the hills and valleys on a map.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该地区的地形，并在地图上标出了山丘和山谷。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex din il-mixja tidher diffiċli? Pawlu: Ħares lejn it-topografija fuq il-mappa: hemm ħafna għoljiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does this walk look difficult? Pawlu: Look at the topography on the map: there are lots of hills.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么这条步行路线看起来很难走？保罗：看看地图上的地形：那里有很多山丘。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 为什么这条步行路线看起来很难走？
messages.en: Why does this walk look difficult?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn it-topografija fuq il-mappa: hemm ħafna għoljiet.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn it-topografija fuq il-mappa: hemm ħafna għoljiet.
messages.zh: 看看地图上的地形：那里有很多山丘。
messages.en: Look at the topography on the map: there are lots of hills.

stratified_content_samples.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 topografija 想成一张展示山丘、山谷和高低起伏的地图：它回答“这片土地是什么形状”，也可指研究这些特征的学问。

senses.en_definition: To work out the meaning of a coded message or read writing that is difficult to understand.
senses.zh_definition: 解开编码信息的含义，或辨认难以读懂的文字。
senses.mt_definition: Jifhem messaġġ miktub b'kodiċi jew jaqra kitba li tkun diffiċli biex tingħaraf.

senses.zh_definition: 破译、解码；辨读难认的文字。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ddeċifra l-messaġġ billi qabbel is-simboli ma' dawk f'dokumenti oħra.
formal.en: The researcher deciphered the message by comparing its symbols with those in other documents.
formal.zh: 研究人员把信息中的符号与其他文献中的符号进行比较，从而破译了这条信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' taqra x'hemm fuq din in-nota? Ben: Jien le, imma Toni ddeċifra l-kitba u qal li l-laqgħa fit-tlieta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you read what is on this note? Ben: I cannot, but Toni deciphered the handwriting and said the meeting is at three.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你能看懂这张便条写了什么吗？本：我看不懂，不过托尼辨认出了字迹，说会议是三点。

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien le, imma Toni ddeċifra l-kitba u qal li l-laqgħa fit-tlieta.

Christmas Eve, the final night immediately before Christmas.

senses.mt_definition: Il-lejl eżatt qabel il-Milied.

senses.zh_definition: 圣诞前夜，即圣诞节到来之前的最后一夜。

formal.mt: F'Lejlet il-Milied, il-mużew se jagħlaq fis-siegħa ta' waranofsinhar.
formal.en: On Christmas Eve, the museum will close at one in the afternoon.
formal.zh: 圣诞前夜当天，博物馆将于下午一点闭馆。

senses.en_definition: A relative pronoun introducing a clause that identifies or describes a person or thing, corresponding to who, which, or that.
senses.zh_definition: 引导关系从句，说明前面的某个人或事物，相当于英语的 who、which 或 that；汉语常译为“……的”。
senses.mt_definition: Pronom relattiv li jintroduċi sentenza li tidentifika jew tiddeskrivi persuna jew ħaġa msemmija qabel.

senses.zh_definition: 关系代词，指代前文的人或事物并引出说明，汉语通常用“……的”表达。
连词，引出陈述内容的从句，相当于英语 that；汉语常不单独译出。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ikkonferma li d-dokument li rċieva kien komplut.
formal.en: The committee confirmed that the document which it had received was complete.
formal.zh: 委员会确认，收到的文件是完整的。

colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the book that I lent you? Mark: I think it's on the table. Let me check.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我借给你的那本书在哪里？Mark：我想在桌上。我看看。

senses.en_definition: The act of eating food very quickly and greedily.
senses.zh_definition: 急切而快速地吞吃食物的行为。
senses.mt_definition: L-att li tiekol l-ikel bil-għaġla u bir-regħba.

senses.zh_definition: 狼吞虎咽地吃东西；急吞食物的行为

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-ħġim tal-ikel juri kemm il-vjaġġatur kien bil-ġuħ.
formal.en: In the story, the wolfing down of food shows how hungry the traveller was.
formal.zh: 故事中，旅人狼吞虎咽地吃东西，表现出他当时有多饿。

senses.en_definition: To insult someone, call them offensive names, or engage in insulting speech.
senses.zh_definition: 用言语侮辱别人、以难听的称呼骂人，或进行辱骂。
senses.mt_definition: Tinsulta lil xi ħadd, issejjaħlu b'ismijiet offensivi, jew toqgħod tgħid kliem ta' tgħajjir.

senses.zh_definition: 侮辱；以言语冒犯别人。
用难听或侮辱性的称呼骂某人。

formal.mt: Ma għandekx tgħajjar lil ħaddieħor b'ismijiet offensivi waqt diskussjoni.
formal.en: You should not call other people offensive names during a discussion.
formal.zh: 讨论时，你不应该用侮辱性的称呼骂别人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tgħid li ma taqbilx mingħajr ma tgħajjar lil ħadd. Ben: Għandek raġun; se nispjega għaliex ma naqbilx.
colloquial.en: Maja: You can say you disagree without insulting anyone. Ben: You're right; I'll explain why I disagree.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你可以表达不同意见，不必辱骂任何人。本：你说得对，我会解释自己为什么不同意。

senses.en_definition: A cracking sound or a series of short, sharp cracking sounds.
senses.zh_definition: 物体发出的短促清脆的咔嚓声，或连续的噼啪声。
senses.mt_definition: Ħoss qasir u qawwi, jew sensiela ta' ħsejjes bħal dawk ta' friegħi niexfa meta jinkisru.

senses.zh_definition: 连续或反复发出的噼啪声、咔嚓声。
一声短促清脆的咔嚓声或噼啪声。

formal.en: During the night, the crackling of the wood in the fire could be heard throughout the room.
formal.zh: 夜里，炉火中木头的噼啪声传遍了整个房间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Smajt dak iċ-ċaqċiq? Maja: Iva, kienet fergħa niexfa li ksirt taħt saqajja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you hear that cracking sound? Maja: Yes, it was a dry branch I broke underfoot.
